scenes.title: Hook
scenes.text: Thirty paper quizzes. One red pen. Your whole evening. There is a faster way, and it is already in your pocket.

scenes.title: Build the assignment
scenes.text: Build the assignment in Brains Heist like any other. Pick the class, pull questions from the bank, and set delivery to Paper.

scenes.title: Print the sheets
scenes.text: Hit Print papers. Every student gets their own answer sheet, with their name, the assignment code, a unique QR code, and four corner markers.

scenes.title: Students answer on paper
scenes.text: Students answer the old-fashioned way. One bubble per question, dark pencil or pen. No devices needed in the exam room.

scenes.title: Scan with a phone
scenes.text: Now the magic. Open Scan and review, add the photos from your phone, and watch. The QR code matches each sheet to its student, the corners straighten the photo, and every bubble is read on the spot.

scenes.title: Review flagged marks
scenes.text: Not sure about a smudged mark? Neither is the scanner, and it says so. Question seven is flagged. You see the crop, you tap the right answer, you save. Nothing is graded blind.

scenes.title: Results
scenes.text: Confirm the batch, and the results land in the gradebook, with a full report for every student, right next to their online work.

scenes.title: Outro
scenes.text: Print. Scan. Done. Brains Heist. Paper exams, digital speed.
